formula: 𝒢 = G · M / r²   (direction radiale attractive)
sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas with a large source mass M (a planet) at center.
Canvas2D overlay renders radial gravitational field 𝒢 = G·M/r² ·
(-r̂) as inward-pointing arrows. Draggable test point shows local 𝒢
magnitude readout (in N/kg or m/s²). Student adjusts M via slider
(planet grows visually). Experiment: match a target |𝒢| at a fixed
radius by choosing M (e.g., "what mass gives lunar surface
gravity?"). Evaluate: field arrows hidden; only a marker at target
r and target |𝒢| — student picks M. Wrinkle: N/kg (equivalent to
m/s²) — good moment to surface the unit duality. Directly reuses
champ-electrique infrastructure.
